736:t_1:326.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So, $$ノノ$$... If you're going to set off into space, then I'm coming with you. So let's go with our heads held high.」

736:t_1:329.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Then, for what little it's worth, count me in as well. Even if the power of the $$トップレス$$ is lost, in that case I'll be of service with this brain of mine.」

736:t_1:330.en:
$$シモン$$
「All right...! I'll take care of the whole lot of you!」

736:t_1:331.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Um... $$シモン$$... If you haven't decided where to go yet, there's a place $$ノノ$$ wants to go.」

736:t_1:332.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「A place you want to go...? Into space...!?」

736:t_1:334.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...That $$シモン$$ guy is positive to the very end.」

736:t_1:335.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「What are we going to do?」

736:t_1:337.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Even when the fighting is over, there's no one waiting for us... In this world, we are complete outsiders.」

736:t_1:340.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Look around. We have this many comrades.」

736:t_1:341.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We could get hired by $$ミスリル$$, go to the $$バジュラ$$ home planet, or join $$大グレン団$$. It's up to us.」

736:t_1:342.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Freedom... is that what you mean?」

736:t_1:345.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「First, let's go back to $$聖天使学園$$.」

736:t_1:346.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Right. Ever since the $$時獄戦役$$ ended, we've been buried in special training and haven't been back.」

736:t_1:347.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I want to see everyone at the academy, too, and tell them what's happened so far.」

736:t_1:348.en:
$$アンディ$$
「That's right! We've got to teach those guys about the wonders of boy-girl union, too!」

736:t_1:349.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$アンディ$$! Dating between boys and girls is...」

736:t_1:350.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「It isn't banned anymore, is it?」

736:t_1:351.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Besides, nothing $$ＭＩＸ$$ says is very convincing, you know~」

736:t_1:353.en:
$$シュレード$$
「So even $$聖天使学園$$'s very existence is going to change.」

736:t_1:354.en:
$$クレア$$
「When the times change, people change... And when people change, the times move, too... That's just how it is.」

736:t_1:355.en:
$$モロイ$$
「So $$カグラ$$ and $$ジン$$ are transferring back into the academy all over again?」

736:t_1:356.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Before that, I'm planning to drop by $$アルテア$$.」

736:t_1:357.en:
$$ジン$$
「Now that you mention it, what with the $$サイデリアル$$ invasion, we haven't been back since then.」

736:t_1:358.en:
$$カグラ$$
「That's all the more reason to do this, $$アマタ$$, $$アポロ$$!」

736:t_1:360.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We have a dream of a future to walk toward with the people who matter to us. For that... we can't lose.」

736:t_1:362.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「Aren't you going to go to everyone?」

736:t_1:364.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「Don't you have a dream, $$碇$$?」

736:t_1:365.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I want to move forward into the future, too. But to do that...」

736:t_1:366.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You mean you'll atone for the past?」

736:t_1:368.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I don't care what you do, but if you die, that's the end of everything, you know.」

736:t_1:371.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Make sure you come back alive, Brat $$シンジ$$.」

736:t_1:373.en:
$$マリ$$
「You finally got it out, Princess.」

736:t_1:376.en:
$$カヲル$$
(That's how it should be, $$シンジ$$... A smile really does suit you, now that you're alive.)

736:t_1:377.en:
$$モーム$$
「Nobody has given up, have they, $$桂$$?」

736:t_1:380.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $$モーム$$. I guess I got a little sentimental.」

736:t_1:381.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You feel it too, then, $$桂$$...」

736:t_1:382.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah... Something I felt when I set off the $$時空震動弾|lc$$... It's swelling up inside me again...」

736:t_1:384.en:
$$桂$$
「I've always thought it was strange. That a botched $$時空震動弾|lc$$ could destroy the walls between all the parallel worlds...」

736:t_1:385.en:
$$桂$$
「But ever since coming down to $$エス・テラン$$, I've somehow started to grasp the truth of it...」

736:t_1:387.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「A $$時空震動|lc$$ that affects every parallel world... If something like that were to happen...」

736:t_1:388.en:
$$桂$$
「I bet it has to do with this world... with the $$カオス・コスモス$$ that connects to every parallel world.」

736:t_1:390.en:
$$オルソン$$
「There must be an answer here on $$エス・テラン$$... The answer to a true $$時空修復|lc$$ that saves the universe from the great collapse...」

736:t_1:392.en:
$$オルソン$$
「That's right. That is your mission... and ours.」

736:t_1:393.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「If the great collapse of the universe refers to the spacetime collapse of every parallel world...」

736:t_1:394.en:
$$桂$$
「If we try to stabilize the dimensional boundary lines, maybe we can avoid it.」

736:t_1:395.en:
$$オルソン$$
「But for that, we'd need to work out the mechanism by which the great collapse occurs.」

736:t_1:396.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「The ones who lead the universe to collapse... the natural enemy of humanity... the ones born of the force that seeks to vanish... $$バアル$$...」

736:t_1:398.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「...Are you ready, Ensign $$セツコ・オハラ$$?」

736:t_1:399.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes, sir. As a member of $$グローリー・スター$$, I swear to act as a soldier should, to the very end.」

736:t_1:400.en:
$$トビー$$
「Chief... A pre-battle oath? Nobody goes in for that these days.」

736:t_1:401.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「I think so, too. So we'll skip the part where we leave a will.」

736:t_1:402.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「I have no intention of dying, either.」

736:t_1:403.en:
$$トビー$$
「You're shining, Chief. And not just the top of your head.」

736:t_1:404.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「For the record, it's just shaved.」

736:t_1:405.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「That's how it is, $$セツコ$$. We're coming back alive and sharing a victory beer.」
